cors: not observed on a successful response (none on the 401 or the 403).
bot_blocking: Two layers. (1) The AWS load balancer answers the relay User-Agent with HTTP 403 (118-byte 'awselb/2.0' page) on every path on both results.okelections.gov and results.okelections.us; headless Chrome (its default HeadlessChrome User-Agent) got the same 403. A desktop Chrome User-Agent gets 200 for the page, JS and config.json. (2) The data API (/OKERS/enrapi/…) then wants 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. The app obtains the token by sending PUT /OKERS/enrapi/login/ with a JSON body {Username:"appuser", Password:<a key hard-coded in main.*.bundle.js as this.connKey>}. I did NOT send that login request: the brief forbids logging in, so the token step and everything behind it are untested.
